critique: The interface achieves strong functional clarity through its three-panel layout and logical grouping, but the execution feels disconnected—the vibrant rainbow keyboard clashes with the muted UI chrome, creating a jarring visual hierarchy. While the behavioral affordances are clear (buttons, sliders, color swatches), the spatial relationships feel unbalanced with excessive negative space in the center panel competing with the dense controls on the sides, undermining what could be a cohesive music-to-color experience.
